profile.headline: Full-stack Developer
profile.summary: Passion for exploration, eagerness for improvement and personal growth, and communication have made up the common thread of my work life. Exposure to web development at a growing startup and the support of collaborators pushed me to find work I truly care about, as well as the belief in my ability to get it done. I have always held a strong passion to make connections between teams, disciplines and technologies.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Building full-stack applications throughout the product lifecycle from concept to deploying to production. Developed skills in Agile methodologies, Ruby, Ruby on Rails, and JS frameworks. Client-centered projects put focus on shipping quality, well-tested code. Developed transparency and project-health practices by using Travis, AWS, and Heroku for deployment to staging and production environments.

positions.title: Full-stack Developer
positions.description: Built and maintained multiple applications throughout product life-cycle. Built from scratch, or maintained multiple UI platforms including online ordering application, internal-facing tools, status monitoring applications using EmberJS. Maintained, expanded, tested and debugged our server-side application built in Ruby on Rails.

positions.title: QA Developer
positions.description:
Develop and maintain a variety of software technologies from UI built in ReactJS and Backbone to Ruby based UI/API Test Automation suites. Authored UI Automation framework called "WatirBottle" to enable QA Testers to write functional automated test scenarios. Authored Ruby API Library for Yesmail services called "YMRB" which enabled both UI and API Automation suites deeper integration with the services they were testing. This made writing tests easier and reduced test run-time by hours.

Skills Used:
ReactJS,  Ruby, HTML, CSS, Git,  Automation (Cucumber, Watir, RSpec, RestClient), Jenkins

positions.title: Sales Fulfillment Specialist
positions.description: Ensured the accurate and timely approval and creation of client accounts. Maintained client relationship from start date to account creation and live date. Inspected account details submitted by Sales Department for clarity and accuracy. Monitored progress of client account, interacting directly with client and with sales staff and managers to ensure customer satisfaction throughout the account creation, order fulfillment and sales support cycle. Assisted in development of Salesforce applications for the improvement of team process and functionality. Successfully reduced the lead-to-live process by significant margins improving customer satisfaction.

positions.title: Legislative Correspondent - Office of Raul Grijalva
positions.locationName: Washington D.C. Metro Area & Tucson, Arizona
positions.description: Maintained written communication between the Representative and constituents and interest groups on a wide variety of political and constituent concerns. Wrote speeches for public events and hearings. Held meetings with constituents and special interest groups on behalf of the Member on issues related to telecom, communications, and technology. Represented the Congressman in constituent meetings and staff the Congressman at meetings and events. Developed the office strategy for responding to large volumes of written and electronic mail. Wrote press releases, compiled daily press clips, monitored local media and major wire stories. Oversaw all constituent communications, electronic and traditional, including writing all responses and e-newsletters.

projects.title: Shine the Chi (formerly "First Responder")
projects.description: 8-day capstone project at Dev Bootcamp.  Our app, "Shine the Chi", provided a mobile interface for citizens of Chicago to report things such as potholes, graffiti, and rodent complaints directly to the city of Chicago.  It used interactive maps as well as the Chicago Open311 API, and it was based in Ruby on Rails, with a Bootstrap front-end.

projects.title: OSU-Research (DBC "client project")
projects.description: Phase 3 project at Dev Bootcamp - build a "client project" in 3 days based on the client's specifications.  Our project was to build a website that would allow faculty and staff in the OSU psychological research program to interact and plan experiments more efficiently using a Ruby on Rails framework.
